_comment: Cardone's original wording, lightly structured into the term-sheet schema as-is (no fixes applied), to run through J.lint(). The point is that the schema itself cannot express 'a major exchange' or 'the price of Bitcoin' usefully -- it is deliberately under-specified to mirror what a maker would actually type.
